title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Members: Supplement on the Late-Delivery Make-Good
content:
Membership benefit note for Delivery Claims: holders of a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan receive a supplement on the late-delivery make-good of a Late Delivery Claim.

**Benefit.** The Unlimited plan supplement depends on the customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership: an Unlimited Next-Day Annual membership in status trial, active or cancellation pending adds 10.00 USD; any other Unlimited plan in one of those statuses adds 5.00 USD; a customer with no such membership gets no supplement.

| Unlimited plan held | Membership status | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | trial, active or cancellation pending | 10.00 USD |
| Unlimited Standard Monthly, Unlimited Student Annual, Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Monthly or Unlimited Express Annual | trial, active or cancellation pending | 5.00 USD |
| any Unlimited plan | any other status | none |
| no Unlimited membership | — | none |

## Points of judgement

- The plan and status are read from the customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership record, not from the customer's description of their benefits.
- A membership in trial counts as fully as an active one; so does a membership whose cancellation is pending.
- *Hypothetical:* a customer whose Unlimited Express Annual membership is cancellation pending adds 5.00 USD; had the same customer held Unlimited Next-Day Annual in that status, the supplement would be 10.00 USD.
